Three routes were tried and all three are closed: one array definition carries only the first name; four separate definitions cannot reproduce the layout, because the linker aligns every emitted .data section to 4 and the 2-byte object at 0x02113a24 pushes ..a26 to 0x02113a28 and everything after it by 4; and splitting the .data claim around the table is refused by the manifest schema, which supports one contiguous contribution per section name. Promotion needs either multi-range section claims or an interior-alias policy. The 16 functions all reproduce byte for byte, so the text half is done.
